activity.notes: After Lenin's death in 1924, Stalin emerged through a prolonged intra-party power struggle as the Soviet Union's dominant leader. The start is intentionally approximate because there was no single constitutional transfer of supreme authority. This Activity preserves the reviewed 1924-1953 de facto leadership interval without conflating it with Stalin's distinct formal party and government offices.

sources.title: Succession of Leadership, Soviet — Encyclopedia.com
sources.citation_text: The reference describes the post-Lenin power struggle after 1924 and Stalin's emergence as the Soviet Union's top leader through control of the party apparatus.
